items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: But my name is Elizabeth. Elizabeth Mary Landreau.

ctx.x: Now, what about your name? We want to get that down straight. How did you happen to get the name Lizzie Miles?

Well, they said, just like for a good billing, they'd say, Miles, I used to be smiling all the time. They said, Miles of smiles from Lizzie Miles. But my name is Elizabeth. Elizabeth Mary Landreau. That's my maiden name. And then my marriage name is Elizabeth Pajot.
Pajot, is that the same as Willie Pajot?
